title: Village Hall Booking System Database Design
originalRequest: Develop the backend database schema and conflict resolution logic for a village hall reservation system.
latestMessage: Develop the backend database schema and conflict resolution logic for a village hall reservation system.

steps.title: Design Database Schema with Overlap Prevention
steps.instruction: Create a SQL schema representing rooms and bookings, utilizing PostgreSQL range types and exclusion constraints to prevent overlapping reservations.
steps.acceptance: The schema must successfully block overlapping bookings in SQL tests while allowing non-overlapping and perfectly adjacent bookings.
